reviewed: V8 streaming and accounting call chain
findings: Generation schema uses the complete public query and public language type set only.
control_response_text is capacity-only, preserves canonical JSON values, and is not invoked during inference.
The actual HTTP completion body preserves node-before-changes order and retains the bytes; legacy/full remain canonical.
Actual returned GBNF is checked per public variant after the base generation succeeds.
A post-generation GBNF failure retains terminal SSE usage through last_usage_receipt and partial_usage; cost recovery does not turn the attempt into success.
Finalization still records counters, closes the owned engine and binds identities. Main requires fresh 3/3 with per-attempt decoder wire checks.
